notes: Expected second backward error: Trying to backward through the graph a second time (or directly access saved tensors after they have already been freed). Saved intermediate values of the graph are freed when you call .backward() or autograd.grad(). Specify retain_graph=True if you need to backward through the graph a second time or if you need to access saved tensors after calling backward.
Repeated backward with retain_graph accumulates grad: 8.0
Dependency graph: x -> x^2 -> log(x^2); x -> sin(x); multiply -> +1/x -> f.
